2025–Present
Delivered reusable React/TypeScript components inside Electron with accessible, responsive UI patterns plus Jest/React Testing Library coverage so compliance reports went in without manual errors.

Supported the launch of the design conference 2025 and 2026 site on Next.js/TypeScript with Sanity CMS and Storybook, extending the design system to cut duplicate code and keep the experience polished.

Technologies: React, Next.js, Electron, TypeScript, SCSS, Node.js/Express, Prisma ORM, Sanity CMS, Storybook, GSAP, Cypress, Jest, React Testing Library, GitHub Actions, ESLint, Prettier, localization & accessibility tools.
